name: Spaceship 2e4467c0 on the 2-uniform tiling k2-004
description: A period-3 spaceship on the 2-uniform tiling k2-004 (touching neighbours), 4 to 6 cells, moving one lattice step every 3 generations (c/3). It runs the same way in the 2,048 rules from B3/S35 to B3,6,7,8,9,10/S0,3,5,6,7,8,9,10; the scene uses the rule it was found in. Its live cells also evolve the same way on k2-003, k3-010, k3-013, k3-016 and k3-019, where the empty tiles around them have other neighbour counts. The range of rules depends on the tiling: 2,048 rules on k2-004, k2-003, k3-010 and k3-016; 32,768 rules on k3-013 and k3-019. Found by JETCARP's soup search (seen 19 times). To our knowledge not reported before.
